notes.title: Helltaker's Anniversary Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/E1HRCXOXIAQRFQG?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a new bonus chapter to the chapter select. You can go play it right now!
[*] Some people said my game was too hard, so I made all the action sequences skippable. However, you still need to win in the old-fashioned way if you want them sweet achievements.
[*] Updated the artbook to feature concepts from the new chapter and Beel [url=https://youtu.be/dbNx8Jzfdrc]stream sprites[/url].
[*] The update is featuring some sweet new music from Mittsies. If you haven't already, buy the Helltaker OST on [url=https://mittsies.bandcamp.com/]Mittsies' bandcamp[/url] to support the musician! New tracks are already added in.
[*] Just go play the update and let me know how horrible it was. Happy anniversary everyone!
[/list]

notes.title: Helltaker Anniversary Stream and Lucifer Nendoroid.
notes.notes:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/E0ddWH6WQAE9Pm9?format=jpg&name=medium[/img]
[b]It's already been a year since Beelzebub shared the Helltaker's story for the first time.[/b]
Join me on [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC3mT-q8s9eaiAmK1b70WZ2w]my youtube[/url] on Monday, 10th May at 16:00 CEST, for the anniversary stream. I'll most likely do nothing but draw the fly girl all evening. People been requesting me to draw tiny dancing sprites for Beelzebub, since she's the only girl missing those. I'll will update the artbook to feature them on the next day. And don't worry if you miss the stream, I'll post the link to the archived vid on the next day as well.

***

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/E0db8izWEAQTCFH?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]
[b]If you've been waiting for official Helltaker merch, then I have more good news.[/b]
Pre-orders for Lucifer Nendoroid [url=s.goodsmile.link/6eb]started last week[/url], and she's looking pretty damn cute. What more I can say? Orders open until the 10th of June.

***

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EpxkUzIXYAIg7Uf?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
[b]By the way, have you seen the Helltaker comics already?[/b]
It's no secret that I've been drawing them on my twitter since the game came out. But, if you somehow missed them - that's great! [url=https://twitter.com/i/events/1257962875831947264]Now's as good time as any to read them.[/url] They are absolutely horrible and infamous for ruining the game's characters, but that's the best part.

***

Thank you for all the support. It's been a crazy year.
I'll see you on the stream!

notes.title: Helltaker nominated for Best Soundtrack
notes.notes:
Helltaker OST is nominated for the Best Soundtrack of 2020 Steam Award. A big thank you to everyone who voted to nominate, you made this possible! It makes me very happy to see Mittsies' music appreciated on this level. Regardless of whoever wins the award in the end, this is a glorious success!

What more I can say? You can [url=https://mittsies.bandcamp.com/album/helltaker-soundtrack]buy the Helltaker's OST on bandcamp[/url] if you want to directly support the artist responsible for those sweet tracks.

Stay tuned for our future shenanigans. I hope we will have something nice to show you next year.
Take care and have a great 2021!

You now have the option to choose to play the game in Windowed mode and adjust the window size.

If you had any display resolution problems with the default fullscreen setting, try it out.
